meta.name: cross-border-ecommerce
meta.description: Cross-border e-commerce expansion advisor. Scores target markets on 8 weighted dimensions (market size, ecommerce penetration, competition, regulatory complexity, logistics infrastructure, payment ecosystem, cultural distance, IP protection), compares 5 fulfillment models with cost and transit data, provides country-by-country tax/duty compliance guides (EU VAT/IOSS, UK VAT, US sales tax, CA GST, AU GST, JP consumption tax), maps local payment preferences by market, and builds a phased expansion roadmap. No API key required.

copy.tagline: 评估海外市场并制定跨境扩张路线图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在规划跨境电商的海外市场进入策略。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate overseas markets and build a cross-border expansion roadmap.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning an overseas market entry for your ecommerce business.
